requirement: Desktop first run: /login?onboard=1 draws the sign-in in the Setup frame; /login, the web and old users are unchanged

oracle.invariant: onboard=1: the Setup frame, four steps, step 1 current, steps 2-4 disabled, no Skip/Continue, the email form a GET to /signin/email and no sign-in script. /login, onboard=0 and onboard=true: no Setup frame, the classic POST /login form with its script. /signin/email: 302 to /login?email=<lowercased address>; a malformed address and a foreign next are dropped (302 /login); nothing is mailed. A desktop round accepts an email (200); a lane round with one, a malformed one and one over 254 characters are refused (400).
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
